strategy: Prioritize movement toward the goal direction when unobstructed, checking FORWARD first, then LEFT, then RIGHT. Stop if all paths are blocked.

decisions.condition: The goal is ahead and the front is clear
The goal is to the left and the left direction is clear
The goal is to the right and the right direction is clear
All directions are blocked or the goal is unreachable

stop_condition: All directions are blocked, preventing further movement toward the goal
